constraints.explanation: a leaf is at most four leaf positions long across the tile, so a texel need look at no farther leaves
a leaf is at most four leaf positions long down the tile, so a texel need look at no farther leaves
the nearest leaf, fold and all, stays inside the height range

controls.explanation: Each leaf takes one of these greens.
controls.label: Leaf colours

controls.explanation: How many leaf positions fit across one tile.
controls.label: Leaves across

controls.explanation: How many leaf positions fit down one tile.
controls.label: Leaves down

controls.explanation: How long a leaf is, from its stalk to its tip.
controls.label: Leaf length

controls.explanation: How wide a leaf is at its widest, as a share of its length.
controls.label: Leaf width

controls.explanation: The share of leaf positions that hold a leaf where the foliage is thickest.
controls.label: Leaf density

controls.explanation: How many clumps of leaves fit across one tile; more means smaller clumps.
controls.label: Clump size

controls.explanation: How much the foliage thins between clumps: 0 is even foliage, 100 leaves the gaps bare.
controls.label: Gaps between clumps

controls.explanation: How far the farthest leaf lies behind the nearest.
controls.label: Foliage depth

controls.explanation: How far the midrib of a leaf stands above its edges.
controls.label: Leaf fold

controls.explanation: How much darker the farthest leaf is than the nearest, in percent.
controls.label: Depth shading

controls.explanation: How much one leaf differs in brightness from the next.
controls.label: Leaf variation

controls.explanation: How matte a leaf is, in thousandths.
controls.label: Leaf roughness

controls.explanation: Millimetres between the lowest and highest point the height map can hold.
controls.label: Height range

controls.explanation: How far around each point the surface is compared to find crevices.
controls.label: Occlusion radius

controls.explanation: How far below its surroundings a point must sit to be fully shadowed.
controls.label: Occlusion depth

controls.explanation: The darkest a crevice can get, in thousandths.
controls.label: Occlusion strength
